gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed Histologically proven glioblastoma (WHO criteria 2021), absence of IDH mutation demonstrated by negative IDH1 R132H staining on Immunohistochemistry.

candidate_evidence.quote: This study is evaluating an experimental treatment for glioblastoma that uses an investigational drug (5-ALA) combined with a non-invasive ultrasound device (LIDU) to target tumor cells.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Adjuvant Temozolomide ± 5-Aminolevulinic Acid + Low Intensity Diffuse Ultrasound Sonodynamic Therapy System for Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: an investigational drug (5-ALA) combined with a non-invasive ultrasound device (LIDU) to target tumor cells
